title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.15 - the meter stays on screen once a run has recorded anything: ending a fight, walking into a shop or quitting to the menu no longer takes it away, so the numbers can still be read after the match. On launch it comes back up showing the run you were last playing, rather than sitting blank until the next fight. On the run history page it now follows the map point you are looking at and shows that fight's damage; a fight it has no record of - an older run, or one from before the mod was installed - shows an empty window under that fight's name rather than another run's numbers. Checked against game v0.109.1.
